title: CheckResponse::into_answers maps a Jev reply to DecisionAnswers, including the answer-type, criteria, probability and range rules, inside sc
description: CheckResponse::into_answers maps a Jev reply to DecisionAnswers, including the answer-type, criteria, probability and range rules, inside sc-decision-schema. The sc-jev caller only delegates (crates/sc-jev/src/check.rs:156). ADR-SAG-0012 r-5 (docs/architecture.md:1035-1039) says sc-jev still implements every Jev HTTP operation, including 'mapping responses'. ADR-SAG-0030 r-5 (docs/architecture.md:1630-1637) sanctions CheckRequest for building and CheckResponse for parsing. It does not name response-to-answer mapping as moving out of sc-jev. Result: violated on the literal text. The ADR-SAG-0012 r-5 subsection is Active, so an amendment is the only path, and it has to be Active before code can stay. Interpretation risk: a reader who treats 'data-only' as covering pure mapping could read this as upheld. The reviewer reads the literal rule.
